name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
summary: App navigation: a header with your logo, groups, parents with children, a footer, and an icon-only collapsed state.
use_when: Apps with more than five destinations, or sections with sub-pages
avoid_when: Three to five top-level pages: use top tabs

props.SidebarProvider: defaultOpen, open, onOpenChange: the expanded state (Ctrl/Cmd + B toggles it)
props.SidebarMenuButton: isActive, size (default | sm | lg), tooltip (shown when collapsed to icons), asChild

copy.items: Nouns, sentence case, two to four words

a11y: On phones it opens as a Sheet
The active item has data-active and should also get aria-current
